messages:
Mai: Quick sync on the vector preview UI — I'm prototyping a 'compact' toggle for dense result sets. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/wxyz9876/vector-preview-compact. Two main concerns: keyboard discoverability and export UX for large selections. Lex: Loving the compact mode. Couple of layout notes: collapse metadata into a chevron so primary text stays single-line. Move the score pill inline left-aligned with a subtle divider instead of floating. Sam: Accessibility: compact mode must preserve focus order and hit target sizes. If rows shrink below 44px, ensure the checkbox remains 32px target with increased hit area via padding. Also, add `aria-describedby` linking to a short description that tells users what compact mode does. Olivia: Export behavior question: in compact mode users may not realize they selected many rows. Suggest sticky selection counter in toolbar that reads "23 selected (all visible)" and when selecting all results show a persistent banner: "You selected 4,300 results — exports >500 will be queued." Mai: Good call. For the banner text let's use: "Large export queued. You'll get an email when ready. Streaming CSV for <=500 rows." Lex: Microcopy: compact toggle label should be "Condensed rows" and tooltip: "Makes table denser for scanning. Keeps all metadata accessible in inspector." Sam: Keyboard shortcuts: `j/k` navigate rows (vim-style), `x` toggle selection, `Shift+j/k` range select? We should avoid clashes with browser defaults. Add a discoverable keyboard help modal (press `?`). Olivia: Include an export format toggle in modal: CSV or JSONL. JSONL helpful for large exports with nested metadata. Default to CSV. Also add checkbox: "Include embeddings (base64)" — warn about file size. Mai: UX for selection: add "Select visible" vs "Select all results" split button. For mobile narrow widths collapse into cards with a persistent kebab menu for export/share. Sam: A11y for exports: when user triggers export that will be queued, announce with polite live region: `
Export queued: we'll email you when it's ready.
`. Also ensure focus returns predictably after modal closes. Lex: Visuals: add faint background bands to indicate quartiles (top 25%, 25-75%, bottom 25%). Use accessible color ramps and ensure contrasts meet AA for text overlays. Olivia: For the CSV/JSONL schema docs: propose header `id,text,score,dim,metadata` for CSV; for JSONL each line `{"id":"...","text":"...","score":0.92,"embedding":[...],"metadata":{...}}`. Put a small "schema" link in export modal. Mai: Dev constraints: need server-side throttling for streamed exports and a background job for batch exports. Also add an endpoint to check export status by job id. design-bot: Note: Design PR #512 opened with compact toggle and export modal changes. CI: accessibility-lint passed, but e2e flaky on selection persistence. https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/512 Lex: Action items: I'll update Figma to show chevron-collapse, condensed label, and quartile bands (ETA tomorrow). Sam: I'll write the keyboard map and aria snippets, include example live region markup and the `sr-only` note for the queued banner (ETA 48h). Olivia: I'll draft export modal copy, add JSONL option, and create the small schema doc for the modal link. I'll sync with backend on streaming vs queued thresholds. Mai: I'll add backend ticket for job API & throttling and schedule follow-up review next Tue. Thanks! :thumbsup: Lex: Small UX thought: show a tiny progress spinner on the export button for streaming exports (<=500) so users know it's in-progress. Sam: And ensure screen readers announce when streaming completed: `aria-live=\"polite\"` message "Download ready" with direct focusable link. design-bot: Reminder: Design critique Friday 11:00am PT — bring keyboard flow prototypes.
